# Kseniia Shermin

> Performance Marketing Manager with 10+ years of hands-on paid search experience. Experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts spending over $100,000/day, plus Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads. Focused on lead generation for B2C, B2B, and service businesses.

Industries: health insurance (ACA, U65, Medicare O65), life and final expense insurance, auto and home insurance, mental health and behavioral health treatment, telecom and internet service providers, e-commerce (home appliances and consumer goods), and B2B SaaS.

Detailed site content and article summary: https://kseniiashermin.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Home](https://kseniiashermin.com/): Homepage with verified results, services, platform and industry experience, employer information, FAQs, an inline contact form, and a quick inquiry form from the first CTA.
- [Case Studies](https://kseniiashermin.com/case-studies/): Real account results, including a 5X lead gen scale-up in health insurance, a 90-day launch for a mental health brand, a 25X vertical scale-up in insurance lead gen, and 36X order growth in e-commerce.
- [Blog](https://kseniiashermin.com/blog/): Articles on paid search and PPC, written from hands-on account management.
  - [Microsoft Ads vs Google Ads: Cost, Competition, and Bot Traffic (2026 Data)](https://kseniiashermin.com/blog/microsoft-ads-vs-google-ads/): CPC, conversion rate, and cost-per-conversion benchmarks for both platforms, plus the bot-traffic and invalid-click risk that comes with Microsoft Ads' thinner auction, from someone who has managed millions of dollars in budget across both platforms.
  - [Google Ads and Microsoft Ads Audit Checklist (2026)](https://kseniiashermin.com/blog/google-ads-audit-checklist/): A 12-point checklist for auditing a Google Ads or Microsoft Ads account in 2026, from conversion tracking to AI Max and competitors, with red flags for each check.
- [Work With Me](https://kseniiashermin.com/services/): Google Ads and Microsoft Ads audits to investigate performance issues, review structure, settings, and tracking, and provide a written report with findings and a recommended improvement strategy. Account access is required; implementation is discussed separately based on findings and scope. Also offers consultations and ongoing account management, including Meta Ads.
- [For Employers](https://kseniiashermin.com/for-employers/): Paid search leadership, team development, acquisition infrastructure, reporting, and verified results for Head of Growth, Paid Search Director, and Senior Performance Marketing Manager conversations. Open to remote roles or hybrid roles in the San Francisco Bay Area, alongside client engagements.
- [About](https://kseniiashermin.com/about/): Full career history and client testimonials.
- [Contact](https://kseniiashermin.com/contact/): Contact form and direct booking link.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kseniiashermin.com/privacy-policy/): What the site collects, analytics consent, and how to make a privacy request.
- [Terms of Use](https://kseniiashermin.com/terms/): Disclaimers, no guarantee of results, and trademark notice.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://kseniiashermin.com/accessibility/): Accessibility commitments and how to report a problem.
